name: apple-pro-display-xdr

frames.best_why: Wallpaper screen with the dock magnified, a tooltip open and the display glow lit.

tagline: An aluminium monitor mockup whose dock icons magnify and show tooltips.
summary: A photorealistic studio display on a dark backdrop, with a camera dot, a slim stand and a macOS-style dock of app icons. The dock magnifies under the pointer with tooltips, and clicking the screen swaps the wallpaper for a dark app view.
appearance: A silver aluminium monitor with a thin black bezel and a slim stand centred on near-black. Its screen shows a mountain wallpaper above a translucent dock of colourful round-square app icons; the frame carries a soft tinted glow when active.
behaviour: Pointing at the dock swells the icons and pops a small tooltip above them while a coloured glow rings the display. Clicking the screen advances to the next demo, swapping the wallpaper for a dark player window.
demo_content: A mountain-and-cloud wallpaper with a dock of app icons, then a dark window with a blue-orange gradient.
use_when: A portfolio or product page wants a realistic desktop screen to showcase an app or wallpaper in a hero.
avoid_when: It is heavy with inline SVG art and hardcoded aluminium tones, so it suits a showcase rather than a themeable layout.
customise: initialMode picks the first screen demo and screenContent swaps in your own screen; the aluminium tones, dock icons and glow colours are hardcoded in the source.
weight_why: Lots of inline SVG and gradient layers; springs run only on dock hover and mode change.

a11y.note: Dock icons and the cable hole are labelled, but the clickable screen has no keyboard route to change modes.

issues: Nothing signals that the screen is clickable to switch modes.
The dock icons and tooltip text are very small at this scale.
polish_why: Convincing aluminium display with a live dock; the screen is undiscoverable and controls are tiny.
